title: A Picnic by the Lake

intro.speaker: finn
intro.text: You walked all the way here? Well done! The lake road is the shortest, but it's still a good walk on a hot day.

intro.speaker: finn
intro.text: Miss Miriam sent a picnic. Let's share the apples, so everyone on the blanket has the same.

steps.speaker: finn
steps.prompt: Share the apples so every plate has the same.

older.prompt: Share thirteen apples among four plates. What will we do with any left over?

feedback.all_good: Everyone has the same. Now, who's for a paddle?

outro.speaker: finn
outro.text: A picnic tastes better after a long walk. And it tastes best of all when it's shared.

journal_line: I walked to the lake and shared a picnic with Mr. Finn.
